title: DEFENDER RALLY MAKE HISTORY WITH DEBUT DAKAR VICTORY | Defender Rally Media Newsroom
description: Defender Rally have won the 2026 Dakar Rally, the toughest off‑road challenge in the world, in their debut year, as drivers Rokas Baciuška and Oriol Vidal win the Stock class in the Defender Dakar D7X‑R.
